audioUrl.zh-CN: 音频地址，可以是字符串、AudioInfo 对象，或由它们组成的数组；传入数组时显示上一首、下一首按钮。
audioUrl.en-US: Audio address: a string, an AudioInfo object, or an array of them. An array shows the previous and next track buttons.

classNames.zh-CN: 内部各部位的类名，键为 controls、playButton、cover、title、error、sliderTrack、sliderProgress、sliderThumb、toolbar、speed、volumeDropdown、speedDropdown，与组件自带的类名合并。slider* 同时作用于进度条与音量条；speedDropdown 落在倍速菜单容器上。
classNames.en-US: Class names of the inner parts, keyed by controls, playButton, cover, title, error, sliderTrack, sliderProgress, sliderThumb, toolbar, speed, volumeDropdown and speedDropdown; merged with the built-in classes. The slider* keys apply to both the progress and the volume slider; speedDropdown lands on the playback rate menu container.

skipDuration.zh-CN: 后退、前进按钮每次跳转的秒数。
skipDuration.en-US: Seconds skipped by each backward or forward button press.

styles.zh-CN: 内部各部位的内联样式，键同 classNames。
styles.en-US: Inline styles of the inner parts, keyed like classNames.

theme.zh-CN: 播放器主题，可选 dark 或 light。
